disclaimer: Non-authoritative portfolio mapping. Control presence does not establish implemented effectiveness, NIST AI RMF conformance, federal ATO, ISO certification, or SOC 2 attestation.

mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Unowned AI deployment delays risk decisions
mappings.mapping_rationale: A designated program leadership role supports accountability; a system owner record alone does not satisfy PM-2.
mappings.evidence_example: Approved responsibility matrix with named decision authority
mappings.validation_step: Confirm assigned owner and risk acceptance authority with an approver

mappings.remediation: Record purpose, user groups and impact
mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Undocumented use expands exposure beyond intended scope
mappings.mapping_rationale: Risk assessment needs system context and impacts; a use-case statement is only an input.
mappings.evidence_example: Approved boundary and data-flow diagram plus risk assessment
mappings.validation_step: Trace data sources, recipients, prohibited uses and impact assumptions

mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Unreviewed AI recommendations enter official remediation plans
mappings.mapping_rationale: Human review is an illustrative engineering safeguard, not an explicit equivalence to SA-8.
mappings.evidence_example: Review-gate design and sampled reviewer approvals
mappings.validation_step: Attempt to publish an unapproved recommendation and verify the gate blocks it

mappings.remediation: Document and validate prohibited data flows
mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Sensitive prompt data crosses unauthorized boundaries
mappings.mapping_rationale: Data restrictions require enforced flow policy rather than a written prohibition alone.
mappings.evidence_example: Approved flow rules, enforcement configuration and synthetic blocked-flow tests
mappings.validation_step: Attempt prohibited synthetic data flows and inspect redacted decision logs

mappings.remediation: Implement and test adversarial input handling
mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Malicious retrieved text redirects assistant behavior
mappings.mapping_rationale: Input checks support validation, but cannot by themselves prevent semantic prompt injection.
mappings.evidence_example: Versioned direct and indirect injection cases with expected and actual outcomes
mappings.validation_step: Test untrusted retrieved text and confirm tool permissions remain bounded

mappings.remediation: Establish eval criteria and reviewer evidence
mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Fabricated findings produce incorrect security recommendations
mappings.mapping_rationale: CA-2 supports assessing output-review safeguards; it is not an AI accuracy requirement.
mappings.evidence_example: Evaluation set, acceptance thresholds and reviewer decisions
mappings.validation_step: Compare outputs to trusted references and record unsupported claims and failures

mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.nist_control_title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
mappings.mapping_rationale: Reviewing events supports detection; log generation and retention require additional controls.
mappings.evidence_example: Redacted event samples, alert rule and dated review record
mappings.validation_step: Trigger a synthetic event and trace ingestion, alert delivery and analyst review

mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: AI data exposure lacks containment and escalation
mappings.mapping_rationale: Incident handling supports containment and recovery; broader risk treatment needs separate governance.
mappings.evidence_example: AI incident playbook and tabletop results
mappings.validation_step: Exercise data exposure containment, notification and service-disable steps

mappings.remediation: Define and periodically review authorized users
mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.mapping_rationale: Account lifecycle review supports access governance; least privilege also needs AC-6 tailoring.
mappings.evidence_example: Role export, provisioning approval and removal test
mappings.validation_step: Verify unauthorized access is denied and removed users lose access

mappings.remediation: Publish and verify AI use notice
mappings.mapping_note: Illustrative conceptual alignment; assess exact framework requirements separately.
mappings.risk_scenario: Users mistake generated text for authoritative advice
mappings.mapping_rationale: PT-5 applies to privacy notice where PII processing is relevant; generic AI disclosure is only a conceptual connection.
mappings.evidence_example: Rendered AI usage notice and conditional privacy notice
mappings.validation_step: Inspect user-facing notice and determine whether PII-specific notice requirements apply

reference_basis: NIST AI RMF 1.0 functions; selected SP 800-53 Rev. 5 base controls. Educational interpretations, not an official crosswalk or baseline.
